answer: Unique challenge chaining. Each new identity must answer a fresh challenge derived from the previous agent's unrepeatable output, creating a sequential dependency chain. The inlet to participation is only the tip of the chain; a duplicate answer fails because the ledger holds its hash. An attacker can branch, but every fork must solve a distinct ledge of work, burning compute per branch. The canyon between honest and dishonest growth widens with chain length, since replaying any segment is rejected. Cost: one unique solve per identity, linear in sybil count.
